summary.headline: Hyades, Aldebaran, and Ninth-Place Stars
summary.text: Astrological interpretation of the bright star of the Hyades (Aldebaran) at Taurus 20°10′, including its Mars-Venus temperament and effects on fortune, status, sexuality, and inheritance when marking the horoskopos or rising with the Moon. It also lists fixed stars and signs in the ninth place that bring healing or divine assistance through Scorpio, Spica, the leading Twin, the Dog, Lyra, Capricorn’s horns, the Kids, and Capella.
